formulaBlock.normalization: Packet list used as normalized; normalized one-based positions.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4); no reinforcing route -> moderate.
cleansingStrength.counterSignals: Coco-Glucoside (14) after Parfum, not a buffer; irrelevant to C1.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Several light routes: Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (17), weak refatters Glyceryl Oleate (13), Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate (18), Lecithin (19), Tocopherol/Ascorbyl Palmitate (10, 11), pearlizer Glycol Distearate (15), with humectants Urea (3), Glycerin (5), Panthenol (8). C2 not met (no silicone, no payload lipid).
conditioningLevel.counterSignals: The guar and all refatters except Tocopherol/Ascorbyl Palmitate are after Parfum; humectants give little slip.

weightPotential.rationale: Late guar and weak refatters only; effective C1 reset.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Light, late routes against an effective reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: two families, but the guar is after Parfum and the other family is weak_refatter only (plus humectants); no silicone, payload lipid or film former.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Guar level unknown; step toward moderate realistic.

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula-only: prominent Urea, Glycerin, Panthenol, Allantoin suggest a dry/sensitive-scalp candidate (scalp_active) if positioned; Piroctone Olamine (22) is a recognized active (dandruff path only with a dandruff claim).

usageRole.rationale: Default; treatment if a qualifying dandruff claim is revealed; frequent with frequency wording.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Positioning unknown. CSA formula half met: prominent comfort routes Urea (3), Panthenol (8), Allantoin (9); humectant routes Urea, Glycerin (5), Sodium Lactate (7), Panthenol.

formulaFacts.role: E4 humectant list (pH buffer for C2)
